arc-carousel.description: Keyboard focus and assistive technology now skip the outer, non-interactive cards.

carousel.description: The usage guide clarifies which carousel to choose for timed or continuous automatic motion.

coverflow-carousel.description: Keyboard focus and assistive technology now skip cards behind the immediate neighbours.

modal.description: Dismissed panels become inactive as soon as the exit animation begins.

stack-carousel.description: Only the top card is interactive, including when tabbing through buttons and links.
